source_text:
καὶ ἡ σύνθεσις, ἀπομνημονεύσαντός τινος τὰ ἀποστολικὰ, καὶ ὡσπερεὶ
σχολιογραφήσαντος τὰ εἰρημένα ὑπὸ τοῦ διδασκάλου. Εἴ τις οὖν Ἐκκλησία ἔχει
ταύτην τὴν Ἐπιστολὴν ὡς Παύλου, αὕτη εὐδοκιμείτω καὶ ἐπὶ τούτῳ, οὐ γὰρ εἰκῆ οἱ
pass_a_gloss: —and the composition belong to someone who remembered the apostolic sayings and, as it were, wrote scholia on the things said by the teacher. If then any church has this letter as Paul's, let that church be well thought of also for this; for it is not without reason that the

lemmas.gloss: let it stand in good repute

pass_b_english: —and the composition come from someone who remembered the apostolic teaching and drafted it almost like lecture notes on what the master said. So if any church holds this letter as Paul's, let it be honored for that as well. The old witnesses did not pass it down as his for nothing—the

choices.choice: lecture-note / scholia metaphor for a recorder of the teacher's words.
let the church stand in good credit for holding Hebrews as Paul's.
not without reason / not lightly—tradition has weight.

notes: True OET complete literary English covering locked Greek
